string-array.name: steps
string-array.item: Settings → About phone → Software information → tap Build number 7 times.
Tap Start pairing above, then go to Settings → Developer options and turn on Wireless debugging (Wi-Fi required).
Tap Wireless debugging → Pair device with pairing code.
Type the 6-digit code into the Limpid notification without leaving the dialog (or use split screen and type it here).
Done. Limpid grants itself the permissions it needs and starts its service.

resources.string: After a reboot, Limpid turns wireless debugging back on and restarts its service by itself as soon as you are on Wi-Fi. Once started, it keeps working on mobile data until the next reboot.
Turn off wireless debugging after start
Safer: the service keeps running, but nothing on the network can connect to ADB.

On some Samsung phones with One UI, apps like Facebook play videos with a gray, washed-out haze when the display controller composes the screen (hardware overlays). The video looks right as soon as any system overlay appears, like the volume panel. Disabling HW overlays moves composition to the GPU, so colors are always correct. It is the same switch as Developer options → Disable HW overlays, but applied automatically.
With the fix on, the GPU composes every frame. On a static screen the difference is negligible, but video and scrolling cost a bit more. That is why “Only for selected apps” is recommended.
On Android 13+, apps installed from a downloaded APK need: Settings → Apps → Limpid → ⋮ → Allow restricted settings. Or use “Enable automatically” on the main screen after pairing.
Pairing service found (port %1$d). Enter the 6-digit code in this notification.

Samsung closes the pairing dialog when you switch apps: type the code in the notification, or use split screen. If the port is not detected, copy it from the dialog (IP address and port), e.g. 42965. The connect port is on the Wireless debugging screen.
If built-in pairing does not work on your phone, install and start Shizuku, then come back here.
Shizuku is running. Tap the button and allow Limpid.
Shizuku is running and Limpid has permission.
Limpid uses Shizuku to start its service. After a reboot, Shizuku must be running (it can start itself on Wi-Fi).
